statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-22772 is an SSRF in the fulcio CA via an unanchored regex in pkg/config/config.go (function metaRegex), exploitable through a fulcio MetaIssuer URL when the CA processes a signing request. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/fulcio code directly (fulcio is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a fulcio CA, so the MetaIssuer parser is never invoked.

CVE-2026-22772 is an SSRF in the fulcio CA via an unanchored regex in pkg/config/config.go (function metaRegex), exploitable through a fulcio MetaIssuer URL when the CA processes a signing request. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/fulcio code directly (fulcio is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a fulcio CA, so the MetaIssuer parser is never invoked.

CVE-2025-66506 is a memory-exhaustion bug in fulcio's server-side OIDC handler at pkg/identity/issuerpool.go (function extractIssuerURL), triggered by an attacker-supplied OIDC token on a fulcio CA endpoint. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/fulcio code directly (fulcio is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a fulcio CA, so the vulnerable HTTP handler is never invoked.
